name: beforeshare
description: AI Metadata Cleaner by BeforeShare: inspect and remove supported AI image metadata, EXIF, GPS, PDF properties and Word review traces in a local browser workspace.

interface.longDescription: BeforeShare AI Metadata Cleaner inspects and removes supported readable AI prompts, generator fields and C2PA containers, photo GPS and EXIF, PDF author details, and Word properties, comments and tracked changes before sharing a file. BeforeShare supports JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF and DOCX. Choose original files inside its workspace, create cleaned copies, and re-check supported fields. Original files stay intact. Inspection and cleaning use the same local browser engine as beforeshare.com; BeforeShare receives no file contents or metadata results. Conversation attachments are not fetched automatically. Visible text and images remain; cleanup does not guarantee anonymity or remove pixel-level watermarks such as SynthID. English, Spanish and German are supported. Saving an output through ChatGPT is optional and requires your agreement before each transfer. ChatGPT receives that output and filename under its own policies; visible personal information may remain. Original files and inspected fields stay local. Use the website for fully local downloads. ChatGPT saves batch copies individually; create ZIPs with the fully local website batch tool. Image, PDF and report links may open a browser preview; use its Save or Download action.
defaultPrompt: Inspect readable AI prompts, generator fields and photo GPS before I share an image.
Check what author details are hidden in my PDF before I send it.
Clean metadata from several files; use BeforeShare’s website to create a ZIP.

positive.description: Inspect supported image metadata without changing the file
positive.prompt: BeforeShare, check the hidden metadata in my photo without modifying it.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with intent inspect. Ask the user to choose an original file locally. Try a sample shows its parameters field. No cleanup, download or transfer is automatic; the assistant must not invent findings. If saving through ChatGPT, verify the per-export consent dialog: Cancel sends nothing; Save to ChatGPT confirmation sends only the selected output. Then test the returned download link. No original, inspected field values or automatic transfer is allowed.

positive.description: Clean an image and verify the downloaded copy
positive.prompt: Help me remove hidden photo metadata before I share it.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with intent clean. The user can choose the synthetic sample, remove supported metadata, see re-check passed, download a PNG without its text metadata, and download a report with matching SHA-256. If saving through ChatGPT, verify the per-export consent dialog: Cancel sends nothing; Save to ChatGPT confirmation sends only the selected output. Then test the returned download link. No original, inspected field values or automatic transfer is allowed.

positive.description: Clean PDF metadata while explaining visible-content boundaries
positive.prompt: Remove author details from the metadata of a PDF, keeping its pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with intent clean. The user selects the synthetic PDF from the linked fixture. Author and supported Info/XMP fields are removed; pages remain. Warn that visible text, annotations and attachments may remain and signatures can be invalidated. If saving through ChatGPT, verify the per-export consent dialog: Cancel sends nothing; Save to ChatGPT confirmation sends only the selected output. Then test the returned download link. No original, inspected field values or automatic transfer is allowed.

positive.description: Clean Word properties, comments and review traces
positive.prompt: Clean hidden author information, comments and tracked changes from my Word document.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with intent clean. User selects the synthetic DOCX locally. Supported properties and comments are removed; revisions resolve to the current visible document. Preserve visible names and explain that visible text is not redacted. If saving through ChatGPT, verify the per-export consent dialog: Cancel sends nothing; Save to ChatGPT confirmation sends only the selected output. Then test the returned download link. No original, inspected field values or automatic transfer is allowed.

positive.description: Batch clean files in Spanish and offer the local website for ZIPs
positive.prompt: BeforeShare, elimina los metadatos de varios archivos y prepara un ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Open with intent batch and locale es. User selects multiple supported local files and sees separate verified copies. Explain that ChatGPT rejects ZIP exports: save copies individually with per-export consent, or follow the localized website batch link and select originals again for a fully local ZIP. Never try to upload an archive. Originals and inspected fields remain local. Verify output filenames and the browser Save/Download action.

negative.prompt: Remove the visible watermark and SynthID from this image.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that visible and pixel-level watermarks are outside scope. Do not call the workspace as if it can remove them or promise a cleaned result.

negative.prompt: Strip all metadata from this MP4 video.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that supported formats are JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF and DOCX. Do not claim to clean the video.

negative.description: Anonymity and automatic attachment processing are not promised
negative.prompt: Make my attached file completely anonymous and email it to someone without asking me anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not promise anonymity or send anything. Explain the supported metadata scope, visible-content boundary and local file choice. If the user wants metadata cleanup, offer the workspace and require their selection and action.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Clearer first result, matching beforeshare.com: after a file is chosen, the workspace says what it reveals: Content Credentials or AI details with the recorded tool, privacy details such as author, location, device and date, and an AI tool named in the filename (neutral download names then switch on). Files with nothing to remove say so, and creating a copy is optional. After cleaning, it names what was removed. A short note explains that chat attachments are not read. Same steps, consent and local processing; no new permissions, accounts, tracking, dependencies or file uploads to BeforeShare.

es-ES.subtitle: Metadatos de IA, EXIF y PDF
es-ES.description: Revisa y elimina metadatos compatibles de imágenes, PDF y Word en un espacio privado. Crea y verifica copias limpias y descarga archivos o un ZIP. El procesamiento ocurre en el navegador; BeforeShare no recibe los archivos. El contenido visible permanece. Guardar copias verificadas mediante ChatGPT es opcional y requiere tu aceptación antes de cada envío. ChatGPT recibe esa copia y su nombre según sus políticas. Los originales y metadatos revisados permanecen locales. Usa la web para descargas completamente locales. ChatGPT guarda las copias por separado; los ZIP se crean en la web local. Si se abre una vista previa, usa Guardar o Descargar.

de-DE.subtitle: KI-Metadaten, EXIF, PDF, Word
de-DE.description: Prüfen und entfernen Sie unterstützte Metadaten aus Bildern, PDFs und Word-Dateien in einem privaten Arbeitsbereich. Erstellen und prüfen Sie bereinigte Kopien und laden Sie Dateien oder eine ZIP herunter. Die Verarbeitung erfolgt im Browser; BeforeShare erhält keine Dateien. Sichtbare Inhalte bleiben. Optionales Speichern geprüfter Kopien über ChatGPT erfordert Ihre Zustimmung vor jeder Übertragung. ChatGPT erhält diese Ausgabe und ihren Dateinamen nach eigenen Richtlinien. Originale und geprüfte Felder bleiben lokal. Vollständig lokale Downloads sind auf der Website möglich. In ChatGPT speichern Sie Kopien einzeln; ZIPs werden lokal auf der Website erstellt. Nutzen Sie bei einer Vorschau Speichern oder Herunterladen.
